commentary.text: 90+8' Jose Sanchez is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+1' The game is interrupted. Ben Brereton Diaz (Villarreal) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
90+1' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) gets a yellow card.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Manu Trigueros (Villarreal) will replace Dani Parejo.
88' Michel has decided to substitute Eric Garcia and he is replaced by Daley Blind (Girona).
88' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Viktor Tsygankov walks off the pitch to be replaced by Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona).
87' A yellow card is awarded to Alex Baena (Villarreal).
84' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) blasts the ball high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
84' Girona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
84' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Girona.
82' Ramon Terrats (Villarreal) blasts the ball high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
78' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies onto the right post!
78' Pacheta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ben Brereton Diaz (Villarreal) replacing Jose Luis Morales.
78' Substitution. Raul Albiol walks off the pitch and Matteo Gabbia (Villarreal) comes on as a substitute.

74' What a poor attempt! Cristhian Stuani (Girona) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes yards wide of the left post.
72' Now Villarreal have a corner.
72' The ball goes behind for a corner. Villarreal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
69' That's the end of the game for Artem Dovbyk, who is replaced by Cristhian Stuani (Girona).
64' Girona have a corner.
63' Jose Sanchez sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
63' The Girona players halt their celebrations as referee Jose Sanchez makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
61' 1 - 2 It's a goal! Aleix Garcia sends a long raking pass onto the head of Eric Garcia (Girona), who makes no mistake from close in and sends the ball into the right side of the goal. 1:2.
61' Girona quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
61' Savio (Girona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Girona force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
59' Pacheta has decided to make a change. Ramon Terrats (Villarreal) replaces Etienne Capoue.
59' A substitution has been made. Yeremy Pino goes off and Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) comes on.
58' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Yangel Herrera (Girona) receives a yellow card!
56' 1 - 1 Goal! Savio puts the ball on the head of Artem Dovbyk (Girona), who has the easy task to score into an empty net. 1:1.

56' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Girona are awarded a corner kick.
56' Girona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
53' Michel decides to make a substitution. Ivan Martin will be replaced by Portu (Girona).
52' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Yan Couto (Girona) is coming onto the pitch as Arnau Martinez cannot continue after picking up an injury.
52' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Girona.
52' Savio (Girona) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Girona.
49' 1 - 0 Goal! Paulo Gazzaniga gets a hand on the penalty from Dani Parejo (Villarreal), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom right corner.
48' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
48' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle and signals a foul after Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) brought his opponent down. PENALTY to Villarreal! Let's see who will take responsibility.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
42' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) is caught offside!
39' Alex Baena (Villarreal) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

39' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) weaves through the defence with ease and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score with his strike towards the bottom left corner as Paulo Gazzaniga produces a good save. Villarreal have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
37' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 8:3.

32' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) comes close to scoring. He meets a lovely lofted pass from Savio, but sends his close-range header way over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
31' Alex Baena (Villarreal) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
31' Alex Baena (Villarreal) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Villarreal can continue in their attacking effort.
29' Flag goes up against Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
26' Alex Baena (Villarreal) blasts the ball high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
26' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Girona comes to nothing.
25' The ball is cleared after Savio (Girona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Girona will have a chance to score from a corner.
24' Villarreal have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
24' Alex Baena (Villarreal) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Villarreal get a corner.

18' Yangel Herrera sends a good ball to the edge of the box and Artem Dovbyk (Girona) gets in a shot which goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
16' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
15' Villarreal string together a series of short passes.
10' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.

10' Alex Baena (Villarreal) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a low shot from long range which went towards the middle of the goal, but Paulo Gazzaniga was ready and made a save.
7' Savio (Girona) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
6' Savio (Girona) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
1' CHANCE! Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Girona will kick-off.
Jose Sanchez was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
